name: Failed-transfer refund in {{withdraw}}
description: Make the payout transfer of `{{withdraw}}` fail; the user's balance must be restored, nothing lost or stuck.

checks.message: Could not make the payout transfer fail (`{{withdraw}}` may not pay out with a plain transfer).

`{{withdraw}}` pays out with a plain transfer and no callback, so there is no failure branch to test. The only way to make that transfer fail is the recipient deleting its own account mid-flight, which is self-inflicted, so it is not counted against the contract.

The payout failed but the balance was not restored: a later `{{withdraw}}` of the same 5.0000 NEAR {status.w2} ({error.w2}). The failed-transfer branch loses user funds (the NEAR is stuck in the contract).

explain.held: The payout failed, the contract restored the 5.0000 NEAR balance, and the user withdrew it in full afterwards. Nothing was lost.
